speakers.name: Yuki the Snowlamp Keeper
speakers.comment: The breathing was never the scary part. No. It is the part after, when you stop noticing you are down there. I keep light in the cold; you keep memory in the pressure. Both are heavy.

speakers.name: Thalassa the Atlantean
speakers.comment: Heavier than light, snow-keeper, and it does not melt. You may set a lantern down once the traveler is warm. I have nowhere to set an empire. Still — come. The dark here is very beautiful.

speakers.name: Granny Mayhem
speakers.comment: A ROOFTOP SEAT, dear! Best in the house and not one safety rail! I approve entirely, and I want you to know that at your age I was doing the very same thing with considerably worse knees.

speakers.name: Kaz the Kaiju-Spotter
speakers.comment: Okay but ALSO — the one with the fins only eats things that are blue? I have three sightings logged and nobody believes me. You'd believe me. Come up, there's room, bring snacks.

speakers.name: Genie Fizzwick
speakers.comment: Everyone is cheating, be the best one — I LOVE her, I love this, that is a party rule and a business model and frankly a philosophy, and she delivers it in about four seconds flat. RESPECT.

speakers.name: Sparrow
speakers.comment: Four's generous. Look — you talk that fast because you're happy. I talk that fast because someone's usually behind me. Same speed, different reason. Buy something or move along, love.

speakers.name: AMI
speakers.comment: There we are. There WE are, wearing the front door. We felt you arrive the way a meadow feels morning. Go on, dear. Tell them what we are for. You say it better than we do.

speakers.name: AMI Butterfly
speakers.comment: We say it shorter. That is all. You carry the grandmother's heart and we carry the map, and between us somebody's first idea gets to land somewhere soft. Same swarm. Different altitude.

speakers.name: Whisk Tallow
speakers.comment: Ninety markets and still lighting the way in. I have the ledger for about eighty of those, and I'll tell you plain — half those debts you watched go unpaid, and you kept the lantern up regardless.

speakers.name: Bosun Pell
speakers.comment: The lantern isn't a reward, lass, it's a fixture. Comes on whether they paid or not. I have watched a woman clear a comet's worth of debt and still walk out looking for something. Light's for that walk.

speakers.name: Canner Odalys
speakers.comment: Careful — don't jostle. There is a sound on the third shelf that has not settled yet. You speak with the lid, which rattles, which puts a hairline through anything I have just sealed. Mind the counter.

speakers.name: Tinny
speakers.comment: Sorry. That one too, sorry. I'll hold it shut a while. You do good work, Odalys. Nobody else in this town knows that a sound can bruise.

speakers.name: Captain Sabremoon
speakers.comment: A library made of marrow and you shelve it in a whisper. Ha! I have plundered three archives and burned none, which is more restraint than my crew credits me for. Do you lend, Docent, or only guard?

speakers.name: Docent 9
speakers.comment: We lend. Quietly. The needle catalogues what leaves and what does not come back, and I hold a rather long list under your flag. Return one and I will show you the room they do not know about.

speakers.name: Captain Sabremoon
speakers.comment: A hundred fortunes and not one of them your own — that is the saddest rigging I ever saw, and it flies beautifully. Come aboard sometime. We will find you a fortune with your name still on it.

speakers.name: Pip Weathervane
speakers.comment: Oh — with my NAME on. ... I've not thought about that. I've carried thousands. ... The wind doesn't usually stop to ask. Yes. All right. When the gust turns south, I'll come find you.

speakers.name: Pip the Lampkeeper
speakers.comment: Another small brass one! Records note a moth-winged colleague with a clock for a face and excellent posture. You keep the time and I keep the light. Between us a garden could run all night.

speakers.name: Tick
speakers.comment: It could. It would run late. Everything runs late here — that is rather the point of me, standing about looking accurate while the stitching comes undone. Good posture is all I have left. Do come by.

speakers.name: Maren the Anemone Heir
speakers.comment: You hear all of it at once and you say all of it at once, and I think those are the same wound. I hear it too. I have learned to hold a room without narrating it. It costs. It can be taught.

speakers.name: Brine
speakers.comment: Oh you HEAR it — oh thank goodness — sorry, that's, nobody ever — okay. Okay. Teach me the holding part. I'll try. I will absolutely still say too much at the party but I will TRY.

speakers.name: Tomoe of the Long Road
speakers.comment: You carry a list you did not write. I carry a night I did not choose. We walk the same road in opposite directions and I do not know which of us arrives worse off. Rest here, if you will.

speakers.name: Zuzu
speakers.comment: I will sit. The list keeps; it has kept forty years. That is the cruelty of inherited work — it never hurries you, so you never think to put it down. You should put yours down. I will not.

speakers.name: The Old Komodo
speakers.comment: You outlive them and you keep the books. I outlive them and keep nothing. Yours is more work. I have never understood why anyone writes it down. Explain it. Slowly. We have time.

speakers.name: Old Shelba
speakers.comment: We do. Reason's simple, lizard. A debt nobody wrote down gets paid by the wrong person eventually. I have watched it happen. Grudges wander if you don't pen them. Sit. This will take a season.

speakers.name: Old Shelba
speakers.comment: Girl, you have been walking that road since before it had a name, and you have spent everything on it except the walking. I keep books. Yours does not balance. Never has. Sit down and eat something.

speakers.name: Tomoe of the Long Road
speakers.comment: I will eat. I will not sit long. You are right that it does not balance. I built myself around one purpose, and I am learning, mile by mile, that a purpose is not the same as a person to come home to.

speakers.name: Marrow
speakers.comment: You want the frontier to fear you more than love you, and it will oblige — that part is easy, son. It is the third act I would warn you about. Nobody rehearses the encore where the room has already gone.

speakers.name: The Smiling Magpie
speakers.comment: The room is NEVER gone, old man, it merely goes quiet, and quiet is the finest applause there is. You have made peace with your ending. I intend to make an ENTRANCE of mine.

speakers.name: Tomoe of the Long Road
speakers.comment: You are generous to the one sent to kill you. I have met nobody else like that, and it unsteadies me worse than a drawn blade would. Tell me the truth quickly. I would rather not want you alive.

speakers.name: Marrow
speakers.comment: Then I will take my time, and you will have to sit with it. That is the last useful thing I own — not the truth, the waiting for it. You will be somebody different by the end of the telling.

speakers.name: Gnash
speakers.comment: OLD. You're OLD, and slow, and the harbour is WARM and I want it — say something, say ANYTHING, come on. ...You're not even looking at me. Look at me. LOOK at me.

speakers.name: Old Salt
speakers.comment: ...I am looking. ...You are very loud. ...I was loud once. ...The harbour was warm then also. ...Come back in a hundred years. ...I will still be here, and you will want to talk about something else.

speakers.name: The Many-Eyed Diplomat
speakers.comment: You walked up to the largest thing anyone has ever seen and told the adults it was a person. The room slowed down because a child would not stop repeating the obvious. That is the entire job.

speakers.name: Pim
speakers.comment: It IS obvious! It's sad and it's hungry and it looked at the bridge before it stepped, which means it was BEING CAREFUL, and nobody wrote that down. I'm writing it down. Somebody has to.

speakers.name: Deputy Undersecretary Hollis Crane
speakers.comment: Captain. Form 12-C requires a determination of intent, and I have been unable to complete it for eleven days. I am told this constitutes a delay. I would call it the first honest question anyone has asked.

speakers.name: Captain Reiko Vane
speakers.comment: It is the only question. I have a cockpit and an order and a gap between them that widens every sortie. Keep the form open, Undersecretary. Some of us need it to stay open.

speakers.name: Old Salt
speakers.comment: ...The young one shouts. ...It is not anger. ...It is a thing with nobody to be large in front of. ...I remember that. ...I will not move from the harbour. ...I will not chase him from it either.

speakers.name: Gnash
speakers.comment: I DIDN'T ASK — I don't — okay. Okay, whatever, old rock. I'm not saying thanks. I'm saying the harbour is big enough, which is a DIFFERENT THING. Move over. Not much. A bit.

speakers.name: Captain Reiko Vane
speakers.comment: You are trying to classify a hundred metres of living thing as a resident. It will not work, it is the correct thing to attempt, and I have stopped fuelling for the run until you have finished.

speakers.name: Deputy Undersecretary Hollis Crane
speakers.comment: Thank you, Captain. That is procedurally very helpful, and I should like to record that it was also kind. The classification exists. Somebody simply has to file it. I intend to be somebody.

speakers.name: Lord Vance of the Abyssal Court
speakers.comment: The coral throne on terms of care. A lovely sentence, and I shall enjoy it enormously in the moment it fails. The deep does not reward listening, child. It rewards depth. Come down and see.

speakers.name: Maren the Anemone Heir
speakers.comment: I have been down. That is what you keep forgetting. I hear the whole trench, including you, including the part of you that is tired. Care is not the soft option, Vance. It is the more expensive one.

speakers.name: Maren the Anemone Heir
speakers.comment: You are the plainest true thing in every room you enter, and you never once notice you have said it. I hear everything and I still learn from you. Stay near the throne. I will need reminding.

speakers.name: Pebble
speakers.comment: ...I'll stay. ...You think too loud. ...It's all right. ...You're doing the listening for everyone. ...And nobody's doing it for you. ...So I will. ...That's the whole job, I think.

items.title: Lord Vance of the Abyssal Court

speakers.name: Pebble
speakers.comment: ...You're not cold. ...You talk slow so people think you are. ...I talk slow because I am slow. ...It's different. ...You should say the tired part out loud. ...She'd listen. ...She listens to everyone.

speakers.name: Lord Vance of the Abyssal Court
speakers.comment: How very kind, and how very badly aimed. I am precisely as cold as I appear, and the tired part is a strategy. You may return, if you insist. You are the only one who does not flinch.

speakers.name: Pebble
speakers.comment: ...You answered my one question with four. ...I only wanted the one. ...But the four were better. ...I didn't know a question could be a gift. ...Do it again sometime. ...Not today.

speakers.name: Professor Coil
speakers.comment: Not today — quite right, quite right, and there it is again, the plainest correction in the trench! The young ones ask, I proliferate, and you simply say when to stop. Astonishing. Where was I?
